name: Reparations
seo_title: Reparations in Greater Lansing | Justice League GLM
meta_description: Learn how Justice League GLM advances faith-based reparations, African American wealth equity, scholarships, homeownership, and business development.

hero.heading: Repairing the Breach
hero.description: We bring faith communities and collaborative partners together to address the lasting economic harm of slavery and systemic racism through locally directed reparative action in Greater Lansing.

definition.heading: Repair is more than acknowledgment.
body: For the Justice League, reparations means making amends for harm. Our local model connects faith, repentance, racial justice, accountable relationships, and material action to increase wealth equity for African Americans in the Greater Lansing Area.

This work does not replace state or federal responsibility. It is a local, faith-rooted response: people and institutions confronting the benefits and burdens created by racial injustice, then joining African American community leadership in the work of repair.
definition.callout: Acknowledgment names the breach. Relationship builds accountability. Reparative action begins to close it.

history_heading: The wealth divide was built over generations.
model_heading: A local model for material repair.

action.heading: Take part in the work of repair.
action.description: Individuals, houses of worship, community organizations, and collaborative partners can contribute, learn, share the work, or begin a conversation about participation.
